meta.title: Tactical Briefing Boot
meta.description: A four-beat tactical mission-briefing opening: holographic command table, full-bleed theater map, operator access / systems check, and a mission-start title. The map, route, waypoints, radar and HUD are drawn in code; the terrain relief and holographic table plates are generated with Agnes. No aircraft or photographic combat footage. About 15 seconds, skippable, and played once per application start (never on wake from sleep, tray restore or page reload).
